metadata.title: Pass 3 reference table — reduced 3D conical corallum (septa, endothecal dissepiments, synapticulae), Wells (1956) solitary-corallum apical-angle classes, and Keulegan-Carpenter oscillatory reef-surge regimes for the Chindapol (2013) Péclet boundary-layer flux
metadata.note: Literature values below were recalled offline during the Pass 3 remediation (no network access). Every DOI and every numeric value carries a provenance tag and should be verified online before being treated as a digitised figure/table value. Rows with provenance 'model' are modelling choices of this script, not literature values. Rows with provenance 'specimen' are measured at runtime from the SHA-256-pinned specimen micrograph by the script.

governing_equations.conical_corallum_profile: R(z) = R_ped + z tan(phi/2), 0 <= z <= H = (R_top - R_ped)/tan(phi/2); R(z) non-decreasing so k(R(z)) and N_hex(k(z)) are non-decreasing along the growth axis (Lean turbinate_corallum_septal_cycles_monotone)
governing_equations.septal_insertion_fronts: cycle-k septa present at all z with R(z) >= R_k = (3 lambda_s / pi) 2^(k-1); front heights z_k = (R_k - R_ped)/tan(phi/2)
governing_equations.septum_angular_width: constant physical thickness t_s -> angular half-width t_s / (2 r R(z))
governing_equations.dissepiments: vesicular endothecal plates at z_n = n h_d + (h_d/2)(loculus index mod 2) + tilt (r - 1) h_d, outer zone r >= f_d, thickness t_d (sub-voxel weighted)
governing_equations.synapticulae: rods bridging adjacent septa on rings |r - r_s| R <= t_syn/2 at z_m = m h_syn
governing_equations.keulegan_carpenter: KC = U_max T / L; excursion amplitude a = U_max T / (2 pi) = L KC / (2 pi)
governing_equations.surge_renewal_efficiency: eta(KC) = 1 - exp(-KC / (2 pi)); KC_50 = 2 pi ln 2 = 4.3552
governing_equations.oscillatory_flux: j(theta,t) = j_0 [1 + eta beta sqrt(Pe(t)) sgn(U) cos theta + eta gamma (Pe(t)/(1+Pe(t))) cos 2theta], Pe(t) = Pe_max |sin(omega t)|; period mean of the dipole term is exactly 0 (Lean oscillatory_surge_dipole_cancellation)
governing_equations.mean_sqrt_sin_factor: (1/pi) int_0^pi sqrt(sin x) dx = 0.76276 (closed form B(3/4,1/2)/pi = Gamma(3/4) Gamma(1/2) / (pi Gamma(5/4)); checked numerically in the script)

specimen_side_profile.method: per-row foreground width (gray > 0.15) between the widest row (calice rim) and the narrowest row below it (pedicel waist); OLS slope of half-width vs height -> phi = 2 atan(slope)
specimen_side_profile.note: The dataset README (Pass 1) already describes the corallum as 'costate trochoid'; the side view has an unknown pixel scale (different magnification from the top panel) so only the angle and counts are used. Costae correspond 1:1 to septa in Caryophyllia, so ~N/2 = 20 costae are expected across the visible half; oblique viewing and the dark costal band reduce the detectable count.
